description:
ExitRouter._pay(uint256,address,address,uint256,bool) (src/ExitRouter.sol#455-483) sends eth to arbitrary user
	Dangerous calls:
	- IWETH(WETH).deposit{value: amount}() (src/ExitRouter.sol#461-471)
reason: By design: the call is to the immutable WETH contract, which wraps ETH that the router holds for the owner. The WETH is then sent to the owner, or booked as owed to the owner. There is no recipient argument.

description:
ExitRouter.claimOwed(address,address) (src/ExitRouter.sol#262-274) sends eth to arbitrary user
	Dangerous calls:
	- (ok,None) = owner.call{value: amt}() (src/ExitRouter.sol#268)
reason: By design: the ETH only goes to the position owner (or the owner's owed balance); there is no recipient argument.

description:
FullMath.mulDiv(uint256,uint256,uint256) (src/lib/FullMath.sol#6-43) has bitwise-xor operator ^ instead of the exponentiation operator **: 
	 - inverse = (3 * denominator) ^ 2 (src/lib/FullMath.sol#33)
reason: False positive: the XOR is the intended Newton-Raphson seed of the 512-bit mulDiv, as in OpenZeppelin v4.9 Math.mulDiv, which FullMath follows (not the Uniswap library).

description:
Reentrancy in ExitRouter._settle(uint256,ExitRouter.Position,address[],uint256[],bool) (src/ExitRouter.sol#395-423):
	External calls:
	- _pay(exitId,p.owner,t,d,false) (src/ExitRouter.sol#407)
		- (ok,None) = owner.call{value: amount}() (src/ExitRouter.sol#458)
		- IWETH(WETH).deposit{value: amount}() (src/ExitRouter.sol#461-471)
	- _trySwap(t,d,slip) (src/ExitRouter.sol#413)
		- (ok,ret) = token.call(abi.encodeWithSelector(0x095ea7b3,spender,amount)) (src/lib/SafeTransferLib.sol#42)
		- ! token.tryApprove(SWAP_ROUTER,amount) (src/ExitRouter.sol#436)
		- IV3SwapRouter(SWAP_ROUTER).exactInput(IV3SwapRouter.ExactInputParams({path:path,recipient:address(this),amountIn:amount,amountOutMinimum:minOut})) (src/ExitRouter.sol#440-451)
		- token.tryApprove(SWAP_ROUTER,0) (src/ExitRouter.sol#452)
	- _pay(exitId,p.owner,t,d,false) (src/ExitRouter.sol#419)
		- (ok,None) = owner.call{value: amount}() (src/ExitRouter.sol#458)
		- IWETH(WETH).deposit{value: amount}() (src/ExitRouter.sol#461-471)
	External calls sending eth:
	- _pay(exitId,p.owner,t,d,false) (src/ExitRouter.sol#407)
		- (ok,None) = owner.call{value: amount}() (src/ExitRouter.sol#458)
		- IWETH(WETH).deposit{value: amount}() (src/ExitRouter.sol#461-471)
	- _pay(exitId,p.owner,t,d,false) (src/ExitRouter.sol#419)
		- (ok,None) = owner.call{value: amount}() (src/ExitRouter.sol#458)
		- IWETH(WETH).deposit{value: amount}() (src/ExitRouter.sol#461-471)
	State variables written after the call(s):
	- _pay(exitId,p.owner,t,d,false) (src/ExitRouter.sol#407)
		- owed[owner][WETH] += amount (src/ExitRouter.sol#464)
		- owed[owner][token] += amount (src/ExitRouter.sol#479)
	ExitRouter.owed (src/ExitRouter.sol#92) can be used in cross function reentrancies:
	- ExitRouter.owed (src/ExitRouter.sol#92)
	- _pay(exitId,p.owner,t,d,false) (src/ExitRouter.sol#419)
		- owed[owner][WETH] += amount (src/ExitRouter.sol#464)
		- owed[owner][token] += amount (src/ExitRouter.sol#479)
	ExitRouter.owed (src/ExitRouter.sol#92) can be used in cross function reentrancies:
	- ExitRouter.owed (src/ExitRouter.sol#92)
	- _pay(exitId,p.owner,t,d,false) (src/ExitRouter.sol#407)
		- totalOwed[WETH] += amount (src/ExitRouter.sol#465)
		- totalOwed[token] += amount (src/ExitRouter.sol#480)
	ExitRouter.totalOwed (src/ExitRouter.sol#93) can be used in cross function reentrancies:
	- ExitRouter.totalOwed (src/ExitRouter.sol#93)
	- _pay(exitId,p.owner,t,d,false) (src/ExitRouter.sol#419)
		- totalOwed[WETH] += amount (src/ExitRouter.sol#465)
		- totalOwed[token] += amount (src/ExitRouter.sol#480)
	ExitRouter.totalOwed (src/ExitRouter.sol#93) can be used in cross function reentrancies:
	- ExitRouter.totalOwed (src/ExitRouter.sol#93)
reason: Accepted: exit and claimOwed are nonReentrant, so a callback cannot re-enter the code that books or pays owed balances. arm, disarm and disarmAll are not guarded and can be reached from a callback. That is harmless, because exit works from a memory copy of the position and never reads it from storage again.

description:
FullMath.mulDiv(uint256,uint256,uint256) (src/lib/FullMath.sol#6-43) performs a multiplication on the result of a division:
	- denominator = denominator / twos (src/lib/FullMath.sol#28)
	- inverse *= 2 - denominator * inverse (src/lib/FullMath.sol#35)
reason: False positive: this is the exact-division step of 512-bit mulDiv, as in OpenZeppelin v4.9 Math.mulDiv, which FullMath follows (not the Uniswap library). The divisor is the largest power of two in the denominator, so the division loses nothing.

description: ExitRouter._trySwap(address,uint256,uint16) (src/ExitRouter.sol#427-453) ignores return value by IV3SwapRouter(SWAP_ROUTER).exactInput(IV3SwapRouter.ExactInputParams({path:path,recipient:address(this),amountIn:amount,amountOutMinimum:minOut})) (src/ExitRouter.sol#440-451)

description: ExitRouter._trySwap(address,uint256,uint16) (src/ExitRouter.sol#427-453) ignores return value by token.tryApprove(SWAP_ROUTER,0) (src/ExitRouter.sol#452)
reason: Accepted by design: resetting the approval is best effort. If it fails, the allowance left over is only to SWAP_ROUTER, the immutable Uniswap router the swap already trusts, and the exit is unaffected.
